# tuna_domain (Resource)

A reserved domain or subdomain for tunnels. Set either subdomain (on a built-in zone) or domain (your own domain).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Subdomain on a built-in zone
resource "tuna_domain" "app" {
  subdomain = "myapp"
  location  = "ru"
}

# Your own domain
resource "tuna_domain" "custom" {
  domain   = "app.example.com"
  location = "ru"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `location` (String) Location of the domain (ru or nl).

### Optional

- `domain` (String) Fully qualified domain name. Required unless subdomain is set.
- `domain_zone_id` (Number) ID of the domain zone to register the subdomain in.
- `subdomain` (String) Subdomain on a built-in zone. Required unless domain is set.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String) Validation status of the domain.
- `type` (String) Domain type: dynamic, static or external.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import tuna_domain.app 123
```
